limitations: Rank/genericity result only: no quantitative lower bound on the smallest singular value, no guarantee for discrete or singular delay laws, and no nonlinear Takens theorem. Distinct angular nodes are required. The source PDF and the full related September 2026 generalized-Vandermonde paper were not independently inspected beyond current abstracts and indexed mathematical summaries, leaving residual originality risk.
provenance: Scientific derivation from the generalized temporal Vandermonde matrix in the cited nonuniform stable-Takens model, using a clustered exponential-determinant expansion and the standard zero-measure theorem for nontrivial real-analytic functions.
record_title: Almost-sure full rank for nonuniform Takens Vandermonde matrices
